commands: find tests -name TestResults -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'Running all tests with coverage collection...'
echo 'Note: Each test project generates coverage in tests/<project>/TestResults/'
dotnet test Flowthru.sln --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings coverlet.runsettings --logger "console;verbosity=minimal" || echo 'Some tests failed but coverage was still collected'

options.command: bash -c 'echo "Consolidating coverage from all test projects..."; COVERAGE_FILES=$(find tests -name "coverage.cobertura.xml" -type f | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "Found $COVERAGE_FILES coverage file(s)"; reportgenerator "-reports:tests/**/TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura.xml" "-targetdir:CoverageReport" "-reporttypes:Html;Badges" && echo "✓ Consolidated coverage report: CoverageReport/index.html"'
